answer_1.quote: Unlike sentence-level neural machine translation (NMT), document-level NMT needs to not only model intra-sentence dependencies, but also consider a wide variety of inter-sentence discourse phenomena...

answer_2.quote: For all translation tasks, we report case-insensitive BLEU score as calculated by the multi-bleu.perl script. Besides, ... we propose lexical translation consistency ratio (LTCR)...

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on 500 sentences randomly selected from our test set. ... two annotators ... the task is to pick one of the three options: (1) the first translation is better, (2) the second translation is better, and (3) the translations are equal quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are provided with source sentences and translations, asked to pick the better translation or mark as equal quality.
